title: Pre-validated credentials at construction time should be defended
description: BearerAuth::new() and BasicAuth::new() validate at construction time (empty token, colon in username, illegal header characters) rather than at first use. A simplifying PR might defer validation to auth_header(). Don't: eager validation fails fast with a clear error at the callsite where the credential is created, not deep in a networking stack during the first request. The stored header_string also eliminates per-request allocation.
